scope: Identity shared-service persistence recovery and legitimate source-book retention

before.source: Original published shared services with new targeted regression tests; original error output preserved.

coverage: Unconfirmed profile save restores only own fields/native projection and preserves original failure
False persistence receipt is failure even when data equals draft
Concurrent native values, descriptors and new metadata survive rollback
Confirmed profile/wish write followed by chat switch retains saved data and original-scope receipt
Exact absent/null descriptor containers restored on failure
Other active identity description is never rolled back
Projection rollback failure retains both original persistence and rollback errors
Non-bound modes preserve legitimate selected source book
Missing source or context change during source read causes zero config writes

receipt_contract.confirmed_error: error.receipt = {kind: profile|wish, id, scope: original scope, confirmed: true}; only set after await persistSettings() === true
receipt_contract.unconfirmed_error: Original failure rethrown after conditional own-field rollback; AggregateError only if native projection recovery also throws; field equality never proves persistence.

verification_type: Node tests with actual identity/story services; native persistence/worldbook callbacks are controlled test boundaries. No real host/model/Android claim.
parent_owned_work: UI route integration tests and full build
